parrafo.es: Nails by Yaima es un salón de uñas en Tampa dirigido por Yaima Perdomo, enfocado en manicure gel ruso, extensiones y rellenos en builder gel, y manicure spa de lujo. Cada cita se trabaja con calma y atención real a la cutícula y al detalle.
parrafo.en: Nails by Yaima is a Tampa nail studio run by Yaima Perdomo, focused on Russian gel manicure, builder gel extensions and refills, and luxury spa manicure. Every appointment is handled at its own pace, with real attention to cuticle care and detail.

parrafo_1.en: Nails by Yaima is Yaima Perdomo's studio in Tampa. Specialized in Russian gel manicure and builder gel, every appointment is handled one client at a time, with real time for cuticle work and finish.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientas lo repiten en cada reseña: atención al detalle y un salón siempre limpio y agradable. Con 5.0 de calificación y 160 reseñas en Booksy, el trabajo habla antes que nosotros.
parrafo_2.en: Her clients say it review after review: attention to detail and a salon that is always nice and clean. With a 5.0 rating and 160 reviews on Booksy, the work speaks before we do.
